description: Four square-wave oscillators combined by a digital operation, which gives the harsh stepped tones of early game hardware.

params.text: How much the MOD jack moves the first oscillator's pitch. With nothing patched into MOD this knob is a fine tune instead.
How much the MOD jack moves the second oscillator's pitch. With nothing patched into MOD this knob is a fine tune instead.
How much the MOD jack moves the third oscillator's pitch. With nothing patched into MOD this knob is a fine tune instead.
How much the MOD jack moves the fourth oscillator's pitch. With nothing patched into MOD this knob is a fine tune instead.
Chooses which of three digital operations combines the four oscillators, numbered 1, 2 and 3 on the panel from the top down.

inputs.text: Sets the pitch of all four oscillators at one volt per octave.
Moves the pitch of all four oscillators, each by as much as its own MOD knob allows.

notes: Set Rack's sample rate to 96kHz before using this module. At any other rate it runs at the wrong speed, and a red bar appears across the bottom of the panel saying so.

inputs.0: 1V per octave · continuous · one channel only
